userHint: Name, email and what they may do.
notFound: It is not there any more.
emailTaken: That email is already on another account.
roleHoldsCompanies: {count, plural, one {One company is} other {# companies are}} still on this account. Hand them over first, then change the role.
resetPasswordHint: Type it, tell them, and they change it themselves. Everything they have open is signed out.
passwordTooShort: A password is at least eight characters.
cannotDeactivateSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account.
usersOfficeHint: Reps, marketing and the coordinator are yours to add and manage. A manager’s account and the admin’s are the admin’s alone.
accountIsAdmins: Only the admin changes a manager’s account or the admin’s own.
roleIsAdmins: Only the admin gives somebody the sales manager or admin role.
deactivateHint: They cannot sign in and everything they have open is signed out. Nothing they did is removed, and their companies stay where they are.
activateHint: They can sign in again with the password they had.
companiesOnFloor: {count, plural, =0 {no companies} one {# company} other {# companies}}
sharesWithoutTarget: Counts for this person even with no target
targetsHint: Square metres per month. A blank box is no target, which is a dash on the team screen, not a zero.
earlierHint: Each month as it closed, in m². A dash is no target.
earlierNone: No month before this one has a target.
earlierTail: The newest {shown} of {total} months with a target.
targetMonthClosed: Only this month’s targets can be set. Earlier months stay as they were.
hideHint: It stops being offered in dropdowns. Everything already on it keeps reading correctly.
showHint: It is offered in dropdowns again.
dayHint: A holiday is for everyone; leave is for one person. Both are skipped by pace and by reminders.
daysAdded: {count, plural, =0 {Those days were already there.} one {# day added.} other {# days added.}}
lastDayHint: For one day, leave it as it is. Eid or two weeks of leave is one entry.
removeDayHint: The day counts as a working day again.
removePeriodHint: {count, plural, one {The day counts as a working day again.} other {All # days come off the calendar and count as working days again.}}
periodRemoved: {count, plural, one {One day removed.} other {# days removed.}}
workingDaysOff: {count, plural, =0 {no working days} one {# working day} other {# working days}}
dayAway: {count, plural, one {# person away} other {# people away}}
monthLegend: A shaded day is a company holiday. A dot under a day is one person’s leave.
monthClear: Nothing is off in {month}: the office is open every working day and nobody is away.
useQuietMeans: {days, plural, one {nothing opened in the last day} other {nothing opened in the last # days}}
useDid: {days, plural, one {Changed in the last day} other {Changed in the last # days}}
useDaysAgo: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
emptyArchive: Nothing is archived. Anything taken off the floor turns up here.
archiveQuestion: Taken off the floor by mistake? Find it by its name or its company’s, and put it back.
emptyLookups: Nothing on this list yet — add the first row.
restoreCompanyFirstContact: The contact’s company is archived. Restore the company first.
restoreCompanyFirstProject: The project’s company is archived. Restore the company first.
exportHint: Three files. Excel opens them with the Arabic names intact.
exportFailed: The {file} file could not be prepared.
exportUnreachable: Could not reach the server, so nothing was downloaded.

exportFile.companies: One row per company, with its city, category, lead source, rep and main contact.
exportFile.quotations: One row per item and per service, with the quotation, company, project and rep on each.
exportFile.dispatches: One row per item and per service, with the dispatch, company, warehouse and payment terms on each.

restoreMerged: Nothing to bring back — everything is on the record that continues.
